sm1.name: Caterpie
sm1.effect: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

sm1.name: Metapod
sm1.effect: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

sm1.name: Butterfree
sm1.effect: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

sm1.name: Paras
sm1.effect: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

sm1.name: Parasect
sm1.effect: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

sm1.name: Pinsir
sm1.effect: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

sm1.name: Surskit
sm1.effect: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

sm1.name: Masquerain
sm1.effect: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

sm1.name: Rowlet
sm1.effect: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

sm1.name: Dartrix
sm1.effect: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

sm1.name: Decidueye
sm1.effect: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

sm1.effect: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sm1.name: Grubbin
sm1.effect: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

sm1.name: Fomantis
sm1.effect: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

sm1.name: Lurantis-GX
sm1.effect: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sm1.name: Morelull
sm1.effect: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

sm1.name: Shiinotic
sm1.effect: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

sm1.name: Bounsweet
sm1.effect: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

sm1.name: Steenee
sm1.effect: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

sm1.name: Tsareena
sm1.effect: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

sm1.name: Growlithe
sm1.effect: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

sm1.name: Arcanine
sm1.effect: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

sm1.name: Torkoal
sm1.effect: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

sm1.name: Litten
sm1.effect: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

sm1.name: Torracat
sm1.effect: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

sm1.name: Incineroar
sm1.effect: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

sm1.name: Incineroar-GX
sm1.effect: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sm1.name: Psyduck
sm1.effect: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

sm1.name: Golduck
sm1.effect: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

sm1.name: Poliwag
sm1.effect: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

sm1.name: Poliwhirl
sm1.effect: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

sm1.name: Poliwrath
sm1.effect: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

sm1.name: Shellder
sm1.effect: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

sm1.name: Cloyster
sm1.effect: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

sm1.name: Lapras-GX
sm1.effect: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

sm1.name: Corsola
sm1.effect: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

sm1.name: Wingull
sm1.effect: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

sm1.name: Pelipper
sm1.effect: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

sm1.name: Popplio
sm1.effect: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

sm1.name: Brionne
sm1.effect: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

sm1.name: Primarina

sm1.name: Crabominable
sm1.effect: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

sm1.name: Wishiwashi

sm1.name: Dewpider
sm1.effect: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

sm1.name: Araquanid
sm1.effect: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

sm1.name: Bruxish

sm1.name: Chinchou
sm1.effect: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

sm1.name: Lanturn
sm1.effect: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

sm1.name: Charjabug

sm1.name: Vikavolt

sm1.name: Togedemaru
sm1.effect: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

sm1.name: Zubat

sm1.name: Golbat
